ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets, clustered and slightly yellowish at edges, soft-cooked with a moist, slightly glossy surface, forming a loose mound about 9 cm across and 2.5 cm tall on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown crumbly grain or crumb-like mixture with flecks of green and orange pieces, arranged as a cluster about 6 cm by 5 cm at upper right, with a glazed orange-brown chunk visible beneath it | 110
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-tan sliced piece with a smooth, moist inner face and a browned, grainy coating along one edge, about 8 cm long and 3 cm thick, sitting next to the grain cluster on the right | 100
ITEM 4 | Shredded, stringy dark-brown and tan pieces with visible green specks and a slightly glossy, moist sheen, forming an irregular heap about 7 cm by 5 cm at lower right | 85
ITEM 5 | Small scattered pale cream blobs, soft and matte, roughly 2 cm across, near the cauliflower and at the right edge of the plate | 15
